_comment: ADR-0018 §1. Copy to vault/agents/<agentId>/agent-manifest.json, then SIGN it.
An unsigned manifest is refused unless CAIRN_AGENT_DEV_UNSIGNED=1, and that mode
marks every decision resting on it UNVERIFIED rather than loosening the check.
The publisher's Ed25519 public key goes in vault/agents/publishers/<publisher>.pem.
Signing uses the same canonical JSON as corporate policy — one implementation, so
a signature cannot verify in one path and fail in the other.
agentId MUST match the directory name. A manifest signed for one agent does not
describe another, however valid its signature.
capabilities are SCOPES, narrower than CAIRN's internal read/write/execute:
exec:host may appear here and is NEVER granted to an agent arriving through the
MCP gateway (§3). First-party agents and the operator keep it.
maxDelegationDepth is 0 when absent — an absent limit is not an unlimited one,
and in a chain the MINIMUM governs, so one undeclared link would remove the
expiresAt is re-checked on EVERY read, never once at load (ADR-0016).
signature: <base64 Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of every field except this one>
